test_gumbel_event_shape: test the Gumbel distribution event shape with 1d, 2d, and rank 2 parameter configurations
test_gumbel_sample_shape: test the Gumbel distribution sample shape across multiple broadcasted loc and scale parameter combinations
test_gumbel_log_prob_cdf: test the Gumbel distribution log_prob, prob, cdf, and log_cdf methods with various input values
test_gumbel_entropy_mean_variance: test the Gumbel distribution entropy, mean, variance, stddev, and mode methods with broadcasted parameters
test_gumbel_kl_divergence: test the Gumbel distribution kl_divergence and cross_entropy between two Gumbel distributions in distrax and TFP modes
